title: fieldspec spec 0.1.0
description: A fieldspec spec: the fields of a config or form, their kinds, constraints, defaults and conditions, and how a form for them is drawn. Built-in names are lowercase; names an application or a spec defines are capitalized.

$schema.description: This schema's URL, which names the version the spec is written for.

groups.description: Groups fields may join, for display.

defs.description: Named declarations fields build on with `use`. Names are capitalized.

layouts.description: Named arrangements of the whole form.

functions.description: Functions `$computed` may call, implemented by the application.

anyOf.title: string
anyOf.description: Text.

description.description: What it does, in a sentence.

hint.description: A short line under the control.

aliases.description: Other keys the value is read from.

deprecated.description: true, or what to use instead.

default.description: The value when absent. May be an expression.

visible.description: Shown, and validated, only while this holds.

required.description: Must be non-empty while this holds.

group.description: The id of a group in the same scope.

order.description: Where the field draws among its siblings, lower first; 0 when absent, ties in declaration order.

render.description: A control element (`slider`), or a layout of the field's parts; see Rendering.

pattern.description: A regular expression the whole value must match.

patternMessage.description: Shown when the value does not match `pattern`. Default: "This isn't a valid slug", named after the definition or preset the field uses, else its label or key.

format.description: A known shape: email, uri, uuid, hostname, ipv4, color. Others are kept as hints.

suggestions.description: Values offered as it is typed, others still allowed: strings, or an expression ($state, $computed) giving them.
